1Sam 16v22 ESV
And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Let David remain in my service, for he has found favour in my sight.
?
There is a level of favour, that once you enter into it, makes you irresistible to great men and women.

It’s a level of favour that makes you relevant in high places.

Pray??
Father, bring me to a higher level of favour in Jesus name
